newsitem.title: USA: USDA-- 96/97 centrifugal sugar crop 125 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: USDA-- 96/97 centrifugal sugar crop 125 mln tonnes.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department Wednesday estimated 1996/97 world centrifugal production sugar at a record 125 million tonnes, up from 121.4 million tonnes forecast in September and above the previous record of 122.5 million tonnes in 1995/96.
The department estimated India 1996/97 centrifugal sugar output at 17 million tonnes, up 2.0 million tonnes from 15 million tonnes forecast in September.
It pegged European Union sugar output at 17.2 million tonnes, up from 16.7 million tonnes forecast two months ago.
USDA revised its forecast for Brazil 1996/97 sugar output to 14.5 million tonnes from 14.2 million tonnes. It left its forecast for Cuba 1996/97 production unchanged at 4.6 million tonnes.
The department pegged China sugar production at 7 million tonnes, one million tonnes higher than its September estimate.
It raised its forecast for Poland sugar output to 2.2 million tonnes from 2.1 million tonnes and forecast Ukraine production at 3.0 million tonnes, up from 2.7 million tonnes seen earlier.
USDA estimated sugar produced from sugarcane at 88.6 million tonnes in 1996/97, up two percent from a year ago and above 85.8 million tonnes forecast in September.
Sugar processed from sugarbeets was estimated at 36.4 million tonnes, up one percent from last season and revised up from 35.6 million forecast two months ago.
